display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, var(--ge-light-color, #ffffff)); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Boot self-test, in order:
1. Door Closed (waits up to 60 s)
2. Temperature Sensors (up to 5 s)
3. UV LEDs 405nm (15 s, panel rise ≥ 0.8 °C)
4. UV LEDs 450nm (30 s, same rule)
5. Chamber Fans (tachometers)
6. API Server
LED checks fail as skipped when the door is not closed
